claude.performance_metric: distributed 80.1% of Vontier on 2020-10-09; continuing-ops net earnings $1,452.2M in 2020 (incl. $1,119.2M unrealized gain)
claude.rationale: The slice documents a going concern with rising continuing-operations sales ($3,800.4M in 2018 to $4,634.4M in 2020) and no goodwill impairment for continuing operations across 2018–2020, providing no evidence of product/process interface disruption (p4=0). It likewise records no operations-versus-organization fracture; the only structural event was a further pro rata spin-off of Vontier and the sole impairment ($85.3M, Telematics) fell within the divested/discontinued business, so no realized process/organization break is documented (p5=0). No evidence of controlling-intent archetype incoherence or business-model incompatibility appears in the realized record.

gemini.performance_metric: net earnings from continuing operations of $1,452.2 million in 2020
gemini.rationale: The slice documents an $85.3 million goodwill impairment in the Telematics reporting unit (within discontinued operations), but does not attribute this to product/process integration issues (p4_pathway). There is no documented evidence of process/organization fracture or cultural clashes over time (p5_pathway).
